description: Every project workspace: a project (a bridge, a solver, a messaging protocol) whose orders the layer rebuilds as the generic order steps — its protocol’s stages on the one job lifecycle — with a board per project. Returns: { generated_at, projects[]: { project, name, state: live | lane_pending | no_lane, protocols, filters, key: { scopes, outlets }, webhook: { set }, counts, board } }. ?deliver=1 (the layer’s own keys only) returns the registered rows with their webhook endpoints. (GET /v1/projects; auth: optional-key)
